3	> **⚠ SUPERSEDED IN PART (2026-06-17) — read OPTIMIZATION_LEDGER.md for the current truth.** This doc's

8	> MOVED: decoder = fwd/dX 56.5% (drain-bound) + B1 barrier 19%; **ViT = B1-barrier LOAD-IMBALANCE 51%** (its

12	Synthesis of three independent, read-only, file:line-grounded analyses (decoder+ViT, Mamba-3, shared substrate + multi-GPU), 2026-06-16. Goal: maximize all three model megakernels for 1B+ scale, single- and multi-GPU. Every lever is checked against the **fp64 parity hard-gate + A/A/A determinism**; that is a HARD gate, not a tiebreaker.
13	
14	## TL;DR — the headline
15	
16	**The ~2% roofline is structural, not a knob/scale problem — and the single highest-ROI fix already exists in the codebase, built and silicon-validated, but unused.**
17	
18	- Measured floor (`.task11_perf_authoritative.log`, `PHASE1_CAMPAIGN.md:377-426`): decoder d=2048 = **2.0%** of the 989 TF/s bf16 roofline; ViT = **0.19%**; Mamba-3 can't place at d=2048 (smem-bound), stuck at d=128 (0.03%).
19	- Root cause (all 3 agents independently converged): **(1) no wgmma software pipelining** — the GEMM engine drains every K-step (`wgmma_wait_group<0>` per step; `wait_group<1>/<N>` appears nowhere); **(2) the fused step is mostly non-GEMM fp32 CUDA-core work** (attention/LayerNorm/GELU/bias/residual) that the roofline numerator (GEMM-FLOPs only) ignores but that fills the denominator.
20	- **Scaling alone is a dry well**: decoder is the SAME 2% at d=1024 and d=2048 → scale-invariant cap. Bigger batch is *necessary* for grid-fill (ViT P1 needs B≥8448 for 132 SMs) but cannot amortize the per-K stall or the GEMM fragmentation. Est. <0.2 abs-% from further scaling on current code; the 5–15× lives in the structural levers.
21	
22	## The #1 lever (P0): wire in the dormant pipelined GEMM engine
23	
24	A complete, **mbarrier producer/consumer, register-rebalanced (`setmaxnreg` 232/40), depth-tunable** pipelined wgmma GEMM exists and is **bit-identical by construction** (same ascending-K issue order — the determinism gate "c"):
25	- `csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/tile_pipeline.cuh:272` — `tc_pipelined_gemm_m64nNk16<N, Depth>`, `SG_TUNED_PIPE_DEPTH ∈ {2,3,4}`. Exercised only by `wgmma_selftest.cu:139`.
26	
27	Today the megakernels instead run:
28	- **ViT**: fully unpipelined `tc_gemm_block_unpipelined` (`model_stage_vit_tc.cuh:311-407`; `:346` "no S-stage ring") — measured ~8000-of-8200-cycle bubble per dW K-step (`archived_reports/from_disk_backup/vit_findings.md`: staging-latency-bound, NOT compute, NOT memory).
29	- **Decoder**: a hand-inlined **S=2** cp.async ring for fwd/dX only (`model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:558-632`, capped by `static_assert` at `:120-121`); the **dW GEMM is unpipelined** (lambda sources → `kRingAsync=false` → synchronous `else` at `:633`, `:1544`).
30	
31	**Change:** route fwd/dX/dW through the depth-3–4 producer/consumer engine; sweep `SG_TUNED_PIPE_DEPTH={2,3,4}`. Engineering: adapt the engine (dynamic-smem, one-tile turnkey) into the persistent megakernel's static-smem multi-tile loop; re-check the launcher occupancy gate still returns ≥1 block/SM (Depth=4 operand ring ≈ 32 KB ≪ 227 KB cap). **Parity: SAFE by construction** (reduction-order-invariant). **Risk:** engineering (adapter) + register budget (consumer 232 regs + fp32 accumulator; SAM optimizers already spill → gate depth per-optimizer). **Est. impact: 2–4× ViT, 1.3–2× decoder** (gated by the residual fp32-epilogue wall → P1 below). Shared engine ⇒ one change fixes both models. **More valuable under TP** (see multi-GPU).
32	
33	## Prioritized lever set
34	
35	| # | Lever | Files | Impact | Parity/determinism |
36	|---|---|---|---|---|
37	| **P0** | Pipelined GEMM engine (above) | `tile_pipeline.cuh:272`; `model_stage_{decoder,vit}_tc.cuh` GEMM calls | **Largest.** 2–4× ViT, 1.3–2× dec | SAFE (bit-identical, gate-c) |
38	| **P1** | Fuse the inter-GEMM fp32 epilogues (bias/round into the GEMM epilogue lambda; residual into LN's first read) + overlap epilogue of GEMM k with staging of k+1 | `model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:1046-1188` + ViT twin (~10 `__syncthreads`-separated fp32 passes/layer) | MED-HIGH, multiplicative with P0 (~1.2–1.6×) | SAFE **iff** fp32 fold order preserved (oracle-matching, `:1071-1075`); no atomics/ragged → A/A/A-safe |

40	| **M0** | **Mamba-3: wgmma the projections + decoder-style output-stationary dW** | `model_stage_mamba3.cuh:361-376,440-470,784-794,853-874,1107-1183`; pattern `model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh:93-99,470-677` | **Unblocks Mamba-3 at scale.** Projections are **94% of FLOPs at 1.5B** (not the scan); also collapses the **668 GB** per-CTA grad-workspace wall (`fused_mamba_megakernel.cuh:173-174`) to tile-local; rides the smem fix | SAFE (proven substrate, ascending-k, owner-computes dW; scan untouched) |

43	| S1 | 128B smem swizzle (kills bank conflicts) | `wgmma.cuh:157-172` (`kSwizzleNone`) | small-med | **PARITY-RISKY** (descriptor layout changes) — defer + gate |
44	| S2 | TMA-with-transpose to stream dW operands | `tile_pipeline.cuh:199` (deferred) | med (dW ~30% of ViT) | SAFE landing, high eng cost |

49	## The CUTLASS tension
50	`csrc/backends/cuda/sm_90/mma.cuh` is a real Sm90 TMA+wgmma+fp32-accum collective, but it's **host-launched** and "explicitly REJECTED for the persistent-megakernel path" (`wgmma.cuh:16-18`) — a host collective can't run device-side inside the persistent grid. So the fix is **not** "switch to CUTLASS"; it's **bringing CUTLASS-class technique (multi-stage pipeline + TMA + swizzle + warp-specialization) into the hand-rolled engine** — and the primitives (Mbarrier, `setmaxnreg`, cp.async, the TilePipeline ring) already exist; they're just unwired.

53	- `ParConfig<1,1,1,1>` (`parallel_config.cuh:86`, `kEmitComm=false`) ⇒ every `if constexpr (kEmitComm)` comm branch folds away ⇒ the multi-GPU build is **byte-identical to single-GPU** (PTX-diff gate). 54	- **Counterintuitive but first-order:** TP *shrinks* per-GPU GEMMs (column/row Megatron split → `d/P`-wide shards, `tp_layer.cuh`), which makes per-GPU wgmma utilization **worse** → the P0 pipelining lever is **more** important under TP, and argues for **preferring DP+ZeRO+PP over wide TP** until GEMMs are pipeline-saturated.

56	
57	## Recommended FIRST action (empirical, before big rewrites)
58	Capture the authoritative d=2048 phase breakdowns that don't exist yet (only d=128/d=1024 runs exist), to rank P0/P1/P2 precisely:
59	- Decoder: `python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 2048 --B 16384` (8-phase clock64 split, `decoder_bench.py:185`).
60	- ViT: `scripts/_vit_phase_profile.py` adapted to the d=2048 bench layout (settles the `VIT_TC_001` head-CE question — a measured profile at d=128 found head-CE ≈ 0.4%, contradicting the campaign ledger's "highest-headroom" claim; re-measure at d=2048).
61	
62	## Execution protocol
63	fp64-gated ratchet per [[feedback-patch-protocol]]: apply → build → fp64 parity HARD-gate + A/A/A determinism → 3-seed timing at d=2048 → KEEP iff faster on 3+ seeds AND parity-clean, else REVERT. M2 (chunked scan) additionally requires the fp64 chunked-oracle ≡ sequential-oracle proof first, and stays behind a compile flag until it passes 3 seeds.
64	
65	## Ledger corrections this analysis forces
66	1. "roofline-converged / well-tuned" was **knob-convergence**, not roofline-closure (structural gap remains).
67	2. Mamba "scan-dominated" (`model_stage_mamba_tc.cuh:6-9`) is a **d=128 artifact**; projections = 94% at 1.5B.
68	3. The Mamba per-CTA full-grad-partial reduce is a hard **668 GB OOM at 1.5B** — must go output-stationary before any scale-up.
69	4. ViT's "highest-headroom = head-CE (VIT_TC_001)" is contradicted by a measured profile (head-CE ≈ 0.4%); the real ViT lever is **P0 pipelining** + the B1 imbalance.

1	# compile.py — line-by-line audit (proper + maximal?) — 2026-06-16
2	
3	Full line-by-line audit of `grokking_optimizers/compile.py` (31,461 lines) + the Level-2
4	"superoptimizing additions", run as an 11-agent swarm (10 contiguous line-ranges + 1
5	cross-cutting mandate tracer), each checking **correct · complete · maximal · no-dead-code**
6	against the owner philosophy (MAXIMAL search space; NO fixed trial budget / early-stopping;
7	PTX **and** SASS in scope; correctness is a HARD gate) and the known gaps (#23 tiered spill,
8	#24 roofline objective, fp64-gate wiring).
9	
10	## Executive summary
11	**The search BACKBONE and the correctness GATE machinery are production-grade and honest.** The
12	auto-knob scan (`#ifndef SG_TUNED_*`), the ~10⁶–10¹³ per-arch space, the real convergence-based
13	early-stopping (`n_trials=None`, `max_trials=1M` is only a safety rail), the transitive-include
14	cache-hashing, the default-ON learned cost model that genuinely prunes, and the
15	`_VALIDATION_REQUIRED_ORIGINS × {ok,deterministic}` winner gate are all real and well-defended.
16	The 242-case self-test suite is fully wired with a runtime count-guard.
17	
18	**The gaps are four themes:** (A) the gate is the wrong oracle (fp32 self-consistency, not fp64);
19	(B) the maximal machinery is wired OFF by default and the objective is raw-ms not %-roofline;
20	(C) the Level-2 superoptimizer is ~70% scaffold that the gate correctly prevents from ever
21	winning — *except* one fake-green hole; (D) cache toolchain-identity blind spots.
22	
23	---
24	## P0 — BLOCKERS (correctness / fake-green). Fix before trusting any autotuned winner.
25	
26	1. **fp64 oracle NOT wired into the winner path.** `pick_winner` (6659–6701) accepts winners
27	   on a *same-dtype strict-fp32 self-consistency* oracle (`_capture_reference_output` 13816,
28	   `_compare_outputs` 13878 `np.allclose`) + a 3× same-size determinism tag — never the fp64
29	   ground-truth gate (`tests/hw/test_l3tc_tail_gate.py`). Two kernels sharing a rounding error
30	   agree and pass. **The IL=4 trap (bench-faster, determinism-FAIL) was caught only by the
31	   out-of-band hardware gate, not the tuner.** FIX: inject an fp64+A/A/A hook (like `tune_hook`)
32	   that re-checks the top-K candidate winners at production scale (d=2048) and demotes any
33	   failure to ineligible — make fp64 a hard precondition of `pick_winner`.
34	
35	2. **Polyhedral / CUTLASS / CK winners ship the TEMPLATE while reporting a generated origin
36	   (fake-green).** `build_jit`'s final source-swap (17183) checks ONLY `== ORIGIN_SYNTH`; a
37	   polyhedral winner leaves `final_sources = sources` (the template, 17181) yet records
38	   `origin=polyhedral` at the winning timing. Reachable because `build()` defaults
39	   `enable_polyhedral=True` (17276) + the mirror (17509) force-enables it. FIX: generalize 17183
40	   to any `origin in _VALIDATION_REQUIRED_ORIGINS` with a stashed `_emitted_sources[ckey:origin]`;
41	   reuse the synth warn-and-fall-back-to-template branch (17191).
42	
43	3. **IL=4 determinism trap OPEN by default.** `pick_winner` only *enforces* the `deterministic`
44	   tag when `strict_numerics=True` (6696); the default path lets a `non_deterministic` config
45	   (atomicAdd / IL=4 reduction-order) that merely clears `np.allclose` WIN. FIX: reject
46	   `numerical_status == "non_deterministic"` unconditionally (it's already measured for free);
47	   reserve the opt-out for an explicit `--allow-nondeterministic`. (Also default `strict_numerics=True`.)
48	
49	4. **Fast-math cache signature drops version-gated flags → stale `.so` can win post-upgrade.**
50	   `fm_sig` (14118) omits `_version_gated_flags_for_hash` that the main `build_sig` folds in
51	   (15226). After a gate-crossing compiler upgrade a stale fast-math `.so` is re-served as a
52	   trial and (fast-math being a validation-required origin) can win on stale timing. FIX: fold
53	   the version-gated tuples into `fm_sig` exactly as the main path does.
54	
55	---
56	## P1 — MAXIMALITY (the owner philosophy). High leverage; mostly turning ON what exists.
57	
58	5. **The CLI INVERTS "maximal".** A plain `python -m grokking_optimizers.compile -O adamw -M
59	   decoder` runs with **PGO, device-PGO, emitter, synth, polyhedral, runtime-specialization,
60	   transfer-learning all OFF** and `pruner=none` — the seven `store_true` flags + pruner default
61	   (18808–18834) OVERRIDE `build()`'s documented `True` maximal defaults (17269–17276). The
62	   default invocation is maximally *conservative*. FIX (highest leverage, ~1–2h): tri-state the
63	   flags (`--no-X`, `default=None`, pass `getattr(args,X,None)`) so absent → build()'s True
64	   survives — exactly how `--cost-model`/`--multi-fidelity` already do it. Also `--pruner`
65	   default → `hyperband` (or pick one source of truth: build()=hyperband vs BuildSpec=none).
66	
67	6. **#24 roofline objective ABSENT.** The objective is raw `timing_ms` end-to-end (Optuna
68	   `minimize`, 6335; winner `min(key=timing_ms)`, 6701). No per-arch peak-TFLOP, no
69	   `achieved_tf = FLOPs/wall`, no %-of-roofline, no sub-ceiling flag — the roofline %-numbers
70	   live only in the offline `tuning/roofline.py`. FIX: add `peak_tf`/`peak_bw` to `ArchEntry`;
71	   compute achieved-TF in the timer; switch the objective to maximize %-roofline; flag a winner
72	   that lands below a ceiling threshold (so a structurally-capped 2–4% result is surfaced, not
73	   reported as "tuned"). [#24]
74	
75	7. **#23 tiered register-spill mgmt — PARTIAL, nothing reacts.** The hard parts exist — a
76	   `maxrregcount` cap sweep (2568) and a working ptxas spill-bytes parser (`_parse_ptxas_v_stderr`
77	   12885) — but the parsed `spill_stores`/`stack_frame` are recorded to the sidecar and consumed
78	   by NOTHING. No penalty, no escalation, no enforcement of "never local/DRAM", and they are not
79	   cost-model features (which use only derived proxies like `maxrregcount/255`). FIX: in
80	   `pick_winner`/`_make_trial_record`, treat nonzero local-spill as a tier breach (exclude or
81	   penalize), add `spill_stores`/`stack_frame` as measured cost-model features, and make
82	   `--def-load-cache`/`-Xptxas -dlcm`/`--register-usage-level` *tuned dims* (today pinned base
83	   constants, 12083–12155). Add the genuinely-uncapped maxrregcount point (sentinel → omit flag;
84	   today `0` is aliased to `=255`, different SASS). [#23 + B-flag-resolution]
85	
86	8. **Byte-identical "untuned build" claims are FALSE.** The sm_90 builder's first/canonical
87	   values diverge from the kernel `#define` defaults: `dec_dw_splitk` 4 vs **1**, `vit_dw_splitk`
88	   4 vs **1**, `cons_regs` 200 vs **232**, `prod_regs` 32 vs **40** (A, ~2121–2178). The no-JSON
89	   build is therefore NOT the committed default — it would NOT reproduce the dW `splitk=1` KEEP.
90	   FIX: reorder each value list so the first element equals the in-kernel default. (Direct,
91	   safe, protects the landed dW win.)
92	
93	9. **SASS is not in scope as inspection.** PTX/ptxas flags are tuned, but `cuobjdump
94	   --dump-sass`/`nvdisasm` is never run (`--sass-only` only trims the fatbin). SASS *rewriting* is
95	   genuinely blocked (no assembler — see SUPEROPTIMIZER_SCOPING.md), but SASS *inspection* is
96	   feasible. FIX (optional, for the PTX-AND-SASS ask): a read-only `cuobjdump --dump-sass` pass
97	   recording real reg-alloc / spill-instructions / instruction-mix into the trial sidecar to
98	   inform selection.
99	
100	---
101	## P2 — Level-2 superoptimizer is ~70% scaffold (J). Gate prevents wins, so no corruption — but no maximality added today either.
102	- **Polyhedral** (27147): `apply_schedule` discards the real kernel signature and emits a fixed
103	  `launch_polyhedral_kernel(out,in,n)` — body is a hardcoded identity copy when libclang body-lift
104	  returns None (the common path); dependence analysis `_heuristic_dep_vectors` (27464) is a stub
105	  returning all-parallel `(0,)` vectors; loop bounds are token-scraped (fabricated trip counts).
106	- **Synth/OpGraph** (27947): the "AdamW"/"fused Adam" patterns (28267) never update m/v (consume
107	  stale moments → numerically wrong as a training step); synth `.cu` exports the wrong ABI symbol
108	  (`synth_elementwise_*`, not `launch_<opt>_step`) so the loader can't call it → always
109	  `numerical_fail`. Native wgmma/tcgen05/mfma/wmma mainloop is a hard-OFF zero-fragment STUB
110	  (`_MMA_NATIVE_LOADS_WIRED=False`, 28740) → synth GEMMs fall back to a scalar triple-loop.
111	  `pattern_bilevel_fusion` just concatenates graphs (no real fusion). `_emit_scan_cuda` max-scan
112	  uses identity `0` not `-INF` + single-block only (bug).
113	- **CUTLASS/CK** emitters are real + compilable but never wired into the decoder/vit/mamba
114	  megakernel timing path (only reachable for muon/sg2 GEMM patterns under synth).
115	- **Decision needed (owner fork):** implement these for real (large) vs honestly mark dormant
116	  (set the Python `build()` defaults to match the CLI `False`, fix the scoping-doc claim, and
117	  gate behind explicit opt-in) so the default sweep doesn't waste compiles on layers that cannot
118	  win. Recommended near-term: **honest-dormant + fix blocker #2**; revisit "implement for real"
119	  only if Level-0/1 dries up.
120	
121	## P2 — cache toolchain-identity (F)
122	- nvcc **patch** version not hashed — same-gate-bucket upgrade (12.6.0→12.6.3) silently HITs a
123	  stale binary. FIX: fold `nvcc --version` major.minor.patch into the version-gated hash.
124	- JIT-freshness + PGO-record hashes are inconsistent with the AOT version-gated basis → JIT
125	  re-serves a winner picked for a different binary; **PGO pass-3 record hash can NEVER match its
126	  freshness check (16977) → every build re-runs full 3-pass PGO** (cache-thrash). FIX: record with
127	  the same basis the freshness check uses.

129	  swallowed → all TOML config knobs silently ignored on the live path (the in-file
130	  `apply_to_buildspec`/`DEFAULT_CONFIG` run only in self-tests). FIX: ship the module or route
131	  `build()` through the in-file `load_config`.

133	## P2 — timing methodology (C)
134	- **Multi-GPU clock-lock is half-off:** `_GpuClockLock` pins only GPU 0 (device_index=0,
135	  hardcoded) while `MultiGPUTimingPool` times across all visible GPUs on free-boost clocks. Also
136	  wrong under `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` remap. FIX: one lock per pooled device.
137	- **L2 flush sized at exactly L2 capacity + write-only** → under-evicts (biases toward
138	  L2-resident configs). FIX: ~2× L2 and/or read+write sweep.
139	- Dead duplicate top-level timers (`cuda_graph_median_ms`/`event_median_ms`, 3819–3927) diverged

1	# Codebase audit — repeatable full-tree line-by-line swarm (PROCESS)
2	
3	Owner directive (2026-06-16): **after EVERY landed step, run a comprehensive line-by-line analysis of
4	the ENTIRE codebase** (Opus 4.8 1M, max effort) — exactly like the compile.py audit (COMPILE_AUDIT.md),
5	but tree-wide — looking for **(1) bugs, (2) dead code to clean, (3) dead files to clean.** This doc is
6	the repeatable harness; findings accumulate in `CODEBASE_AUDIT_FINDINGS.md`.
7	
8	## "A step"
9	A completed unit of LANDED work: a commit — a KEEP/REVERT, a fix batch, a perf lever. The audit runs
10	*after* the step's changes are committed + gate-green (auditing a mid-flight, changing tree is wasteful
11	and the P0 compile.py agent / perf gates must finish + commit first).
12	
13	## The swarm (per run)
14	1. **Enumerate** the tree (`git ls-files`), partition the real source into ~contiguous ranges on
15	   file/section boundaries (~2.5–4k lines/agent) across: `csrc/{fused,backends,kernels,common}`,
16	   `grokking_optimizers/`, `tuning/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `examples/`, top-level.
17	2. **Range agents** (general-purpose, Opus 4.8, parallel, READ-ONLY): line-by-line; each returns
18	   structured findings — `SEVERITY{blocker|major|minor|nit} · file:line · CATEGORY{bug | dead-code |
19	   dead-file | not-maximal | correctness-risk | duplication} · desc · concrete fix`. Same skeptical
20	   mandate as the compile.py audit (stubs/TODO/swallowed-except/present-but-OFF/not-strongest).
21	3. **Cross-cutting agents:** (a) **DEAD-FILE graph** — import/include/build/test reachability across
22	   the whole tree (which `.py/.cuh/.cu/.cpp/.h` are never imported/included/compiled/referenced →
23	   dead-file candidates); (b) **DEAD-CODE** — functions/symbols never called; (c) **CONSISTENCY** —
24	   duplicated/diverged logic (e.g. the dead timer twins in compile.py).
25	4. **Synthesize** → append to `CODEBASE_AUDIT_FINDINGS.md`, **deduped** against prior runs (carry
26	   unchanged findings by reference; report NEW issues + the step's changed blast-radius in full).
27	5. **Fix (gated)** per [[feedback-patch-protocol]]: fp64 gate + 242-case self-test stay green.
28	
29	## Deletion discipline (CONSERVATIVE — repo is under active development)
30	- PROVE a file/path is dead (no import/include/build/test/doc reference) before removing.
31	- **FLAG-AND-KEEP** (report, don't delete) anything ambiguous or that I did not create.
32	- KEEP: binaries, build caches, HIP + Pallas backends, dev scaffolding, docs, fp64 oracles, campaign
33	  files, dormant-but-intended infra (e.g. the parallelism scaffolding, the M0 Mamba patch).
34	- Re-validate after every deletion; revert anything that goes red.
35	
36	## Efficiency (faithful, not wasteful)
37	First run = exhaustive full sweep. Per-step runs = full re-sweep with **deduped output** + deep-focus
38	on the changed blast radius + always re-run the (cheap) dead-file/dead-code reachability graph (catches
39	files newly-orphaned by the step). Milestone runs = full exhaustive re-read. Cost is real and is

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# ============================================================================
3	# 12h AUTONOMOUS GPU FRONT-LOAD — runs unattended during the usage-reset gap.
4	# Keeps the H100 productive while the operator (+ the orchestrating model) are
5	# away. RECORDS verdicts/winners to .perf/batch/ for REVIEW — does NOT commit
6	# or auto-ship anything (the keep/revert ratchet stays the operator's call).
7	#
8	# Launch ONLY after the GPU is free (no other timing job) — it owns the GPU.
9	# Robust: every step is timeout-bounded + `|| true` + logged; one failure never
10	# kills the run.
11	# ============================================================================
12	cd /workspace/SuperGrok1.5 || exit 1
13	mkdir -p .perf/batch
14	exec >> .perf/batch/run.log 2>&1
15	set +e
16	echo "==================== FRONT-LOAD START $(date -u) ===================="
17	# shellcheck disable=SC1091
18	source .fast_build_env.sh 2>/dev/null || true
19	
20	# Abort-guard: if compile.py is broken CPU-side, don't waste the GPU window.
21	echo "--- preflight: compile.py --self-test (CPU) ---"
22	if ! CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" timeout 10m python -m grokking_optimizers.compile --self-test > .perf/batch/preflight_selftest.log 2>&1; then
23	  echo "!!! preflight self-test FAILED (rc=$?) — see preflight_selftest.log; ABORTING front-load to avoid wasting the GPU window."
24	  echo "ABORTED-PREFLIGHT $(date -u)" > .perf/batch/DONE
25	  exit 1
26	fi
27	echo "--- preflight OK: $(tail -1 .perf/batch/preflight_selftest.log) ---"
28	
29	# ---- GPU-WAIT GUARD: self-launch when the GPU is free (the ViT B1 gate done) ----
30	# The ViT B1 gate's build phases idle the GPU for <10min; 10 consecutive low
31	# readings (= 10min sustained idle) means it is truly done. The other in-flight
32	# workflows are read-only/worktree-isolated (no GPU), so the GPU's only user is
33	# the ViT B1 gate. Cap at 2h so a stuck gate never blocks the window forever.
34	echo "--- waiting for GPU to free (ViT B1 gate) @ $(date -u) ---"
35	low=0; waited=0
36	while [ "$low" -lt 10 ] && [ "$waited" -lt 7200 ]; do
37	  used=$(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null | head -1 | tr -d ' ')
38	  if [ -n "$used" ] && [ "$used" -lt 4000 ]; then low=$((low+1)); else low=0; fi
39	  sleep 60; waited=$((waited+60))
40	done
41	echo "--- GPU free (low=$low, waited=${waited}s) @ $(date -u) ---"
42	
43	# ---- opportunistically apply the autotuner new-knob registration so the sweep
44	#      explores the NEW perf levers (ViT-B1 sub-tile, decoder ring depth/pipe),
45	#      not just the converged knobs. Guarded: apply only if it applies clean AND
46	#      --self-test still passes; else revert + sweep the existing knobs only. ----
47	if [ -f .perf/autotuner_new_knobs.diff ]; then
48	  if git apply --check .perf/autotuner_new_knobs.diff 2>/dev/null && git apply .perf/autotuner_new_knobs.diff 2>/dev/null; then
49	    if CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" timeout 10m python -m grokking_optimizers.compile --self-test >/dev/null 2>&1; then
50	      echo "--- applied autotuner_new_knobs.diff (sweep WILL explore the new perf levers) ---"
51	    else
52	      git checkout -- grokking_optimizers/compile.py grokking_optimizers/_tuned_inject.py 2>/dev/null
53	      echo "--- autotuner_new_knobs.diff self-test FAILED -> reverted; sweeping existing knobs only ---"
54	    fi
55	  else
56	    echo "--- autotuner_new_knobs.diff did not apply cleanly -> skip; sweeping existing knobs only ---"
57	  fi
58	fi
59	
60	# Enable the autotuner (operator kill-switch; removed for this real tuning run).
61	rm -f .STOP_TUNING && echo "--- removed .STOP_TUNING (autotuner enabled) ---"
62	
63	# ---- 1. Decoder RE-PROFILE @ the shipped 618ms PIPE=1/STAGES=4 build ----
64	# Gate-free diagnostic: re-grounds the STALE relevance gate (the 56.5% fwd/dX +
65	# 19.2% B1 shares were measured at the superseded 920ms build). Read the fresh
66	# phase table from these on return.
67	echo "--- decoder re-profile (coarse 5-slot) @ $(date -u) ---"
68	timeout 30m python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --d 2048 --B 16384 > .perf/batch/decoder_reprofile_coarse.txt 2>&1 || echo "  reprofile-coarse rc=$?"
69	echo "--- decoder re-profile (--fwd-fine) @ $(date -u) ---"
70	timeout 30m python tuning/decoder_bench.py --profile --fwd-fine --d 2048 --B 16384 > .perf/batch/decoder_reprofile_fwdfine.txt 2>&1 || echo "  reprofile-fwdfine rc=$?"
71	
72	# ---- 2. AUTOTUNER SWEEP across the 33 cells (the long autonomous tail) ----
73	# compile.py JIT-builds + fp64-gates + times the flag/macro/structural-variant
74	# space per cell (Optuna-TPE + learned cost-model pruning, RESUMABLE), writing
75	# winners to grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json + populating the cost-model
76	# cache. ~24m/cell x 33 ~= 13h. NOTE on review: the in-loop correctness gate
77	# runs at d=128 (RG4) — winners must be RE-GATED at d=2048 before shipping; this
78	# run RECORDS them for that review, it does not ship.
79	# NOTE: mamba3 is SKIPPED here — its staged-opt scratch is un-gated (BUG-04, scale_correctness_audit.json)
80	# so it OOMs at the d=2048 autotune timing (~199 GiB) AND can't place at d=2048 (M1). Run mamba autotune
81	# on return AFTER the byte-identical kMbStagedOptScratch gate (BUG-04) + M1 land. Decoder/ViT gate it at
82	# bench width, so they autotune cleanly at d=2048.
83	MODELS="decoder vit"   # FIX 2026-06-17: the CLI --model wants the SHORT token (decoder), not
84	# adamw first (the production default / highest value), then the rest.
85	OPTS="adamw lion grokfast grokadamw prodigy muon neuralgrok looksam supergrok11 supergrok15 supergrok2"
86	for model in $MODELS; do
87	  for opt in $OPTS; do
88	    echo "--- autotune  $model / $opt  @ $(date -u) ---"
89	    timeout 32m python -m grokking_optimizers.compile -M "$model" -O "$opt" --arch sm_90 --jit-only \
90	        > ".perf/batch/autotune_${model}_${opt}.log" 2>&1
91	    echo "    -> rc=$? ; winners now in grokking_optimizers/_kernel_tuned.json"
92	  done
93	done
94	
95	echo "==================== FRONT-LOAD DONE $(date -u) ===================="
96	echo "DONE $(date -u)" > .perf/batch/DONE
